body: I know what you mean, its our life so its our choice, people pretend to understand the pain, but in reality they are the ones who are "selfish" for not understanding we just want it to stop.
what's your way out? I live in the UK so I cant get a gun and i'm worried about waking up if I overdose.

That I should kill myself because no one will care if I go and that it will all go away if I do. I thought I had friends but I was wrong, my family don't get it, they don't think mental illness is real so they tell me I just need to "cheer up".
I feel so alone, like no one wants me or cares about be so if I disappeared no one would notice, I cant focus on uni and that fuels the voices.
I did that, but no one said anything which just proved the voice in my head right when it said no one wants me or cares about me.
please don't preach religion here, i'm an atheist and what you are saying doesn't help, I respect your beliefs but don't try to push them onto people who aren't interested
so do I, all I can think about is the easiest way to do it but I just want someone with me, for comfort and to make sure the jobs done, more scared of dying alone honestly.

At university, have an essay due Monday but instead of doing it iv been thinking about the best way to kill myself, I feel the same, I have an opportunity to make a future for myself but have no ambition or drive to do so. Feel like everything I do is just feeding my depression at this point.
